title: Just Juice Vanilla Toffee Tobacco 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Just Juice's Vanilla Toffee Tobacco e-liquid is a decadent flavour that combines the sweetness of vanilla and toffee with the richness of tobacco. The smooth vanilla delivers a velvety sweetness, while the creamy toffee adds a luscious twist. The rich tobacco provides a satisfying base, completing this delightful blend. Indulge in this heavenly combination and let the flavours of vanilla, toffee, and tobacco envelop your senses in a cloud of aromatic sweetness. Shortfill bottles from Just Juice E-liquids provide the ideal way to personalize your nicotine levels to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as an economical and convenient option. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production. Make your vaping more efficient and enjoyable by stocking up on your preferred e-liquids in shortfills. With blends tailor-made to light up your tastebuds, UK E-liquid legends Just Juice create the tangiest, tastiest, fruitiest flavours around. The flavours are long-lasting, less allergenic and easier on the throat than many alternative e-liquids and come in 50/50, Nicotine Salt and shortfills.
